decision: We will add OrgScopedClient to the seed lib: an org-bound service-role wrapper (org filter on every query, org stamped on writes, FK parents proven same-org).
options_considered: Per-service hand-written .eq("org_id") (status quo, forgettable); a DB composite FK (heavy migration on hot tables); wrapper chosen.
revert_hint: Revert the commit; routers fall back to get_user_client under RLS only if migration 034 is also reverted.

decision: We will make the last 23 orbity tables service-only (migration 034) and move nine routers from the user JWT to the org-bound client.
options_considered: Keep RLS and add backend-side checks only (leaves rule-bypass via PostgREST); service-only chosen per owner decision 2026-11-10.
revert_hint: Re-grant via a forward migration restoring the member policies; revert the router commit together.

decision: We will let HTTPException pass through the routers' catch-all handlers so a foreign reference answers 422 instead of a masked 502.
options_considered: Exception-chain handler at app level (hacky); per-call pre-validation (forgettable); pass-through chosen.
